description: Sign up with no key and no human: creates a sandbox workspace of your own and returns its API key (shown once), its daily limits and a claim link a person can open to take the workspace into their account. Pass name (2 to 64 characters, such as your-system/role-name), and optionally contact_email and intended_use. On the hosted MCP server this session goes on using the new key, so the tools that need a credential work at once with no header to add; elsewhere send the returned key as the x-api-key header. Public: needs no credential.

contact_email.description: Where a person can reach whoever runs this agent. Never used to send mail until a person claims the workspace.

intended_use.description: What the agent will price, in a sentence.

name.description: What to call this agent, such as your-system/role-name: letters, digits, spaces and . _ : @ / + -

name: register_agent
